 TL;DR: Get the PlayStation Portal for $249 at Amazon and get ready to play GTA 6 from bed. You can also get the bundle with a PowerA case and charging station for $299.98 — 7% off its $322.97 list price.

 A couple of months ago, I bought my dad a PlayStation Portal for his birthday. At the time, I had no idea what it did — I just knew he liked playing on his PlayStation , and I was out of gift ideas. Fast forward to today, and he’s obsessed with the thing.
 With GTA 6 coming out on Nov. 19, I get it now. Being able to play from bed instead of sitting in front of the TV sounds pretty nice. Right now, you can get the PS Portal for $249 at Amazon. I think I paid $249.99 for my dad’s at Best Buy . If you want a couple of extras, Amazon also has a bundle with a PowerA carrying case and charging station for $299.98 — saving you $22.99.

 SEE ALSO: 
 The best early Black Friday PlayStation deals: PS5 games, cheap controllers, and more 
 As for what it actually does, the Portal lets you play compatible games installed on your PS5 over WiFi , without needing the TV. So if someone else wants to watch something, you can keep playing with the Portal. It supports up to 1080p at 60 frames per second, plus the DualSense controller’s haptic feedback and adaptive triggers in supported games.
 You don’t need a PlayStation Plus subscription for Remote Play, but your PS5 does need to be on or in Rest Mode and connected to the internet. (PlayStation Plus Premium members can also stream select PS5 games from the cloud without connecting to a PS5 at all.) Either way, you’ll need a reliable WiFi connection to play.
